title: Common interview questions
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y10 lesson 9 (Common interview questions (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 9: Applications and interviews. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: 'Tell us about a time you worked in a team.'

parts.text: Task: I organised the stall rota
Action: I made a shared timetable and checked in daily
Result: we raised £180 and nobody missed a shift

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A clear, evidenced answer in under a minute

questions.a: Two or three sentences: who you are, what you study, what you are good at and why you want this role.

questions.q: Why do you want this job or course?
questions.a: A specific reason linked to the role and your plans.
Two strengths, each with an example (STAR).

questions.q: Tell me about a time you worked in a team.
Tell me about a time you solved a problem.
What is one weakness, and what are you doing about it?
questions.a: An honest, small weakness and the steps you are taking.

questions.q: Where do you see yourself in five years?
questions.a: A realistic plan linked to the role.

questions.q: Do you have any questions for us?
questions.a: One or two prepared questions about the role or training.

keywords.def: a form to apply for a job or course
a meeting to see if you suit a role
Situation, Task, Action, Result: a way to answer

questions.q: Answer with STAR: 'Tell us about a time you solved a problem.'
questions.a: A four-part STAR answer with a clear result.

questions.q: Practice interview in breakout pairs: ask three questions from the pupil PDF, answer with STAR, give one strength and one target each.
questions.a: Two practice interviews with written feedback in the portal.

questions.q: Extend: write two questions you could ask the interviewer.
questions.a: For example: 'What training do you offer?'
A) Result. Situation, Task, Action, Result.

questions.q: A good online interview background is ...
Think again: What makes a great first impression on a video interview?
questions.a: Being on time, a tidy background, clear sound, good preparation, honest answers and good manners.
